user.title: Codex Custom Assist
user.description: Connect to an OpenAI-compatible API. For Codex-LB use `{codex_lb_url}`. For other providers (LiteLLM, LocalAI, vLLM, OpenRouter, …) use a URL like `{example_generic}`.

data_description.base_url: OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in `/v1` (or a host root — `/v1` is appended automatically).
data_description.api_key: Provider API key. For Codex-LB with auth disabled, any placeholder (for example `sk-placeholder`) works.
data_description.chat_model: Model id exposed by the provider (for Codex-LB, e.g. `gpt-5.3-codex`).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Codex Custom Assist
reauth_confirm.description: Update the API key or base URL for this provider.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the API base URL.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key for this provider.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This base URL is already configured.

init.title: Codex Custom Assist options
init.description: Tune the conversation agent. These mirror the useful OpenAI Conversation settings that still apply to OpenAI-compatible backends.

data_description.prompt: System instructions for Assist. Leave blank to use Home Assistant’s default assistant prompt.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Allow the model to call Home Assistant tools (Assist control).
data_description.api_protocol: Chat Completions is the most compatible. Use Responses only if your provider implements `/v1/responses`.
